topic: Why the best startup products start with annoying everyday problems

post.topic: Why the best startup products start with annoying everyday problems
post.linkedin_text:
Most failed startups try to build a revolutionary product nobody actually needs.

At JAEXS Solutions, we take the opposite approach. We look for frustrating, everyday inefficiencies that people just accept as normal.

→ If it annoys you daily, it probably annoys others.
→ If it has a manual workaround, there is a market.
→ If the fix is simple, build it fast.

Building in public means sharing these small wins and boring problems as we solve them. You do not need a billion-dollar idea to start building. You just need a real friction point.

What everyday annoyance are you tempted to code a fix for?
